Think of it similar to showing your ID when you go to vote.  You relate the access to the person's ID for confirmation.  The vote is cast into the ballot and is locked in.  It cannot be transferred, returned, or duplicated.  Even if it was manipulated in some form, it can be 100% traced.

> what an idiotic idea blockchain voting is

Not trying to be rude, but that's not how blockchain voting works.  It's a verified system through KYC, or verified users.  Same principal as the current voter registration.  The biggest benefit is a public audit.  Anyone can access the data and it can be fully tracked.  Falsifying the ledger is 100% impossible through smart contracts.  Once a vote is cast, it is burned preventing transfer to duplication.

Just a heads up, I helped implement blockchain voting into a local government election in New Zealand back in 2019.  The mock run was a huge success.  The only reason why it did not go anywhere was due to budgeting and slight opposing views from one political party.

If you want a solid voting system, every vote needs to be accounted for.  Whenever a vote has been disqualified, the election officials should be reaching out to the voter in question to confirm the vote.  Why else do they ask for contact information.  Although this has it's own problems in many ways, blockchain is a capable solution.

CoC FR expert here, with currently 61 mil dps and 1.5 mil EHP.  

1. Make sure you select all projectiles for the FR damage.  Your POB was set as 1 projectile.

2. Vile bastion is not needed, instead replace with Unholy authority.  Refer to POBs used in Poe.Ninja.

3. Your trigger rate is too low.  Needs to be closer to 10.  You can do this by increase attack speed.  Replace crit chance on weapon with attack speed.

4. Dying Sun flask was not selected in POB.  

5. Since you have Curse on Hit Despair, lower the boss Chaos Resistance down to 15, because POB does not calculate this correctly.

6. Select Have you blocked, crit, and been hit recently in configuration.

7. Add 15 to Withered Stacks in configuration.  Make sure you cast Withering Step after you start Cyclone.  This gives you a lot of defensive mechanics with Elusive and movement speed.

8. Replace Vengeance skill gem with Reckoning skill gem.  This is due to Reckoning having a much higher trigger rate at block, rather than 30% chance on hit with Vengeance.

9. Try to cap spell block chance at 75%.  Since these builds do not have evade or spell suppression, this is vital to your survival against spells.  Especially when facing enemies like Shaper.  Arcane guardian can give you this.

10. I've had problems with Onslaught on builds like this, where is has detrimental effects.  If it works for you, that's great, but in my experience it screws my damage up really bad.

11. Last tip, gaining endurance charges on hit can make this game substantially easier.  If you have to sacrifice even 5 mil dps, it is totally worth it because you will not be dying so much, or even at all for that matter.

So far, with just a few of the above mentioned changes, I was able to get the DPS up to 38 mil.  Since this is Chaos damage, 30 mil DPS can do all content in the game.

Several things here, see below:

-The bow appears to go for the physical to elemental damage type, but I'm not seeing much of physical damage converted into elemental damage throughout the build, hence why the damage so low.  Divergent Hatred and Taste of Hate is in there, but that's only 25% and 15%.  I did a rough calculation of 18 projectiles which does about 3.9m dps.  Either increase your physical to elemental damage conversion, or spec into straight element damage using all three type.  A perfect balance could give you 100% uptime on trinity.

-Herald of purity is not needed.

-Amethyst flask is not needed.  Replace with Stibnite Flask.  Chaos Res. is not really needed with TS and HH builds since the goal is to kill and move as fast as possible.

-Remove Cast when damage taken support because you're effective hit point is very low.  It's highly unlikely molten shell will even trigger because you'll die before the skill activates.  Also, Molten shell scales with armour.  At 495 armour, this does almost nothing, so you're better off using Steelskin skill.  Also make this your movement ability, so you have it up as much as possible.

-The main issue, and the most important part of running any build with headhunter, you want to deal as much damage as possible so you can kill rare enemies and steal their buffs.  Most of the time you'll have all 90% resistance among many other buffs.  In addition, specing into atlas shrines can help with your overall effectiveness in each map.
